Population increased in Leicestershire

The estimated population of Leicestershire in 2024 was 745,573 usual residents, a rise of 1.5% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Leicestershire increased by 4.6%.

Age profile of Leicestershire

The average (median) age fell to 42.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Leicestershire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Mid-year population estimates

sections.content:
By age category, Leicestershire's population of 745,573 usual residents was made up of:

  • 130,147 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.5%)
  • 458,077 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.4%)
  • 157,349 people aged 65 years and over, (21.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Leicestershire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (21.1% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Leicestershire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Leicestershire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Leicestershire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 518 people (-0.1%). In total, there were 6,437 births and 6,955 deaths in Leicestershire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 6,910 (0.9%). There were 42,885 people entering the area and 35,975 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Leicestershire's population of 3,373 (0.5%) as a result of 6,105 people entering the area and 2,732 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) led to an increase in Leicestershire's population of 1,572 (0.2%)

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Leicestershire in mid-2023 is 734,236.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,516 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 1,295 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 221 people.
